messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — proposing we UNPIN runtime v1.12 and roll v1.13 into canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC for the global pools. There’s a compatibility note for gpt-open-3a that we should call out. Need thumbs and rollback plan.

release-bot: :robot_face: scheduled canary deploy requested by Sasha — runtime v1.13 -> pool=canary-gpus at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Runbook: deploy.canary -> monitor.KVCacheMismatch, monitor.latency95.

Mike: Quick Q — are we also unpinning model variants? gpt-open-3a has a kv-cache layout change in v1.13; older runtime can't read new kv format.

Tara: We saw one regression in staging last night on long-context streaming. Short log: ```ERROR kvcache: expected keylen=64 got 0 at seq=1024
trace: kvcache/fetch -> chunk-merge``` Not a crash but wrong tokens.

Jonah: Proposal: keep gpt-open-3a pinned to runtime v1.12 on prod stable until we finish a small shim, but unpin runtime for all other models. Canary proceeds as scheduled with strict fallback policy to v1.12 on any KV errors.

Sasha: Sounds reasonable. I'll update the rollout notes and add explicit checks for KV mismatch metric and 95th latency breach. Also adding a canary guard: if KVMismatch > 1% for 5m -> auto-rollback.

Mike: Can we add a targeted canary tag for customers using gpt-open-3a so they stay on the pinned runtime? Otherwise we'll surprise a few enterprise customers.

Sasha: Good call — adding routing rule: traffic.tag!=gpt-open-3a -> eligible for v1.13 canary. Tagged customers remain on v1.12 until we flip.

release-bot: :information_source: runbook updated: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/runtime-unpin-v1-13. Canary guard: metric.kv_mismatch_pct > 1.0 for 5m -> rollback to v1.12. Fallback policy: model-aware routing applied.

devops-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started at 2026-03-21T02:00:12Z on canary-gpus (20 pods). Health checks: ok=0/20 until warmup.

Tara: Watching logs. If you see token corruption on streaming, hit rollback. I’ll instrument extra traces for kvcache keys.

Jonah: Rollback command if needed (from ops account):
```bash
release rollback --pool canary-gpus --from v1.13 --to v1.12 --reason "kv-mismatch"
```

Sasha: Thanks — I’ll be on-call during the window. Tagging @Mike and @Tara for post-mortem notes if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:

Mike: :+1: let’s keep the pinned-model list explicit in the release notes.

Tara: Acknowledged, monitoring alert rule created.

Sasha: Canary green for first 10m, latency fine. Will report back after 30m.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: canary health check passed (10m). Continuing schedule.
